item.title: Bronny James Makes NBA History: The Son-to-Father Assist That Changed Everything
item.description:
Bronny James Makes NBA History: The Son-to-Father Assist That Changed Everything

A stolen ball, a full-court pass, and a thunderous dunk — that’s all it took for Bronny James and LeBron James to write another unprecedented chapter in NBA history.

Key Takeaways

  • Bronny James recorded the first son-to-father assist in NBA history during the Lakers’ 119-103 win over the Warriors
  • LeBron James finished with 26 points and 11 assists, while Bronny contributed 10 points and 3 assists
  • The pair had already completed the first father-to-son assist against the Brooklyn Nets last month
  • The Lakers sit 4th in the Western Conference heading into the playoffs starting April 18

Bronny James and the Historic Steal-to-Dunk Connection

On April 10, 2026, Bronny James stole possession from the Golden State Warriors and fired a pass to his father LeBron, who sprinted the length of the court for an uncontested dunk. It was clean, fast, and historic — the first son-to-father assist in NBA history.

item.title: Spurs Game Tonight: San Antonio's Dominant 57-Win Season and What Comes Next
item.description:
The Spurs Are the NBA’s Most Surprising Powerhouse — and They’re Not Slowing Down

Just two seasons removed from the league’s worst record, the San Antonio Spurs have stormed to a 57–18 record and the No. 2 seed in the Western Conference. With a nine-game winning streak and the Southwest Division already clinched, this team has gone from rebuild to contender faster than anyone predicted.

Key Takeaways

  • The Spurs sit at 57–18, No. 2 in the West, with a 9-game winning streak
  • San Antonio has clinched the Southwest Division title
  • Victor Wembanyama’s health has been a storyline heading into late-season matchups
  • The Warriors, at 36–39, have struggled without Stephen Curry (out 26 straight games)
  • Curry is targeting a return for Houston on Sunday after clearing five-on-five scrimmage work

If you haven’t been paying attention to San Antonio this season, now is the time. Here’s everything you need to know about the Spurs’ remarkable campaign, their recent stretch of games, and what it all means heading into the playoffs.
